observed_volatile._why_not_enforced: The ledger is append-only and grows on every gate run. Pinning it would fail on correct behaviour.

key_mode_meaning.PRODUCTION_KEYED: key at the default path, or CLAIMGATE_LEDGER_KEY_MODE=production AND a non-temp path
key_mode_meaning.TEST_KEYED: any other key location — the FAIL-SAFE default
key_mode_meaning.UNKEYED: no usable key; consistency only, never authorship
key_mode_meaning.<absent>: predates the key_mode field; treat as TEST_KEYED

observed_volatile._authorship_note: No line in this ledger is production-authenticated. A durable record reading KEYED from a throwaway key is exactly what later reads as production authentication.
